title: Discord send fails with Invalid Form Body when the message is longer than 2000 characters
symptoms: content[BASE_TYPE_MAX_LENGTH]: Must be 2000 or fewer in length.
Bot relaying LLM or log output fails only on long answers
cause: Message content is capped at 2000 characters for bots, webhooks and interaction replies alike. Discord counts Unicode code points, so JavaScript string length can overcount emoji but never undercounts.
fix: Split long text into chunks of at most 2000 characters, or send it as a file attachment.
affected: Discord API v10 messages, webhooks and interaction responses, as of 2026-10
